Examples.Title: Get API key usage
Examples.Description: Returns an API key's cost over a time period, in total and by price.
Examples.Code:
### Get API key usage
# @name get-api-key-usage
GET {{host}}/api-keys/{{id}}/usage?start_date=2025-01-01T00:00:00Z&end_date=2025-01-31T23:59:59Z&group_by=day
x-api-key: {{api_key}}
Accept: application/json

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Usage data retrieved successfully
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Bad Request - Invalid parameters
# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing service key
# Content-Type: application/json
# 404
# Description: Not Found - API key does not exist
# Content-Type: application/json
# 500
# Description: Internal Server Error - Failed to fetch usage data
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Rotate API key
Examples.Description: Replaces an API key's secret and returns the new one. The key keeps its `publicId`, name, rate limit, budget, and usage history. The old secret keeps working for `gracePeriodSeconds` (0 revokes it immediately), so the new secret can be rolled out before the old one stops working. A key has at most one previous secret: while it is still in its grace period, rotation returns 409 unless `force` is true.
Examples.Code:
### Rotate API key
# @name rotate-api-key
POST {{host}}/api-keys/{{id}}/rotate
x-api-key: {{api_key}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "gracePeriodSeconds": 86400,
  "force": false
}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: API key rotated successfully
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Bad Request - Invalid parameters
# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing service key
# Content-Type: application/json
# 403
# Description: Forbidden - the key is managed by an integration
# Content-Type: application/json
# 404
# Description: Not Found - API key does not exist
# Content-Type: application/json
# 409
# Description: Conflict - the secret replaced by an earlier rotation is still in its grace period (`previous_secret_active`), or another rotation of the same key finished first (`rotation_conflict`). Nothing was changed.
# Content-Type: application/json
